input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (standing ventures brief)
task: Deepen (flagship 12) ids-model-check: IDS editor ranges on date, time and duration bases (exclusive-bounds 'Not done' items)

doc_friction.issue: Start-here picked einvoice-preflight (row 3) although every item in its next: needs a real outside file or the SAT host (omawww/www.sat.gob.mx refused by the proxy); the row has no inputs_only/buildable marker, so the run spent several calls confirming that before moving to ids-model-check.
Its 'Not done' tolerance note said '"less than 2100" fails a door written 2099.9999999', which is backwards (2099.9999999 < 2100 passes); the shipped hint states the actual IDS rule instead.

deviations.why: Allocator's pick (einvoice-preflight) had nothing buildable here: every next: item needs a real outside file or a blocked SAT host.
deviations.did: Took ids-model-check (flagship 12), whose BUILDABLE HERE item had no claim, and did not add inputs_only to einvoice-preflight since its items change daily and other runs land slices there.
deviations.result: Landed date/duration ranges, the IfcTester float-cast finding with a pattern workaround, and +24 editable facets in public files.

goal: Make the IDS editor write date/time/duration requirements real projects need, in a form the common checkers agree on.
notes: Local checks: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py ids-model-check -> ok (125 tests); node eval/editor-open.mjs -> 64/64 public, 12/12 IDS-Audit, 187/187 pass cases write back the same, audit errors changed on 0; public facets editable 1,714 -> 1,738 (85.2% -> 86.4%), fully editable files 14 -> 17; IDS-Audit-tool 202 -> 214. IfcTester cross-check (ifcopenshell 0.9.0.post1, ifctester 0.9.0) on a 61-door model: date ranges 0/10 agree (IfcTester fails all 61 on every range: float() cast in Restriction.__eq__), datePattern rewrites 10/10 agree with the same failing doors. Playwright on editor.html: 16 range rows open from the eval IDS, 16 IfcTester warnings, 10 Write-as-a-pattern buttons, one click rewrote the row into an xs:pattern, no page errors. Also fixed a contradictory note ('has it on 61 of 61. None ... has it yet') present since #16740. Post checks: frontmatter, links, similarity all clean.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior JS dev: temporal range rows, digit-by-digit date regex generator with fuzz tests, IfcTester cross-check on a synthetic model, page wiring and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
